title: Protecting Tenants at Foreclosure Act - federal basics
facts: Federal law provides certain protections for bona fide tenants when a residential property changes ownership through foreclosure.
A successor in interest generally must provide at least 90 days' notice to vacate to a bona fide tenant, subject to the statute.
A bona fide lease may in some circumstances continue through its term, with an exception related to sale to a purchaser who will occupy the property as a primary residence.
These federal foreclosure protections do not replace broader state or local tenant protections.
